title: Check if All the Integers in a Range Are Covered
summary: Given a 2D array of intervals and two integers left and right, determine if every integer in the range [left, right] is included in at least one interval.
statement: Given a 2D array of intervals and two integers left and right, determine if every integer in the range [left, right] is included in at least one interval. Return true if so, otherwise return false. An integer x is included in an interval [starti, endi] if starti <= x <= endi.
constraints: There are 1 through 50 inclusive intervals with endpoints between 1 and 50.
Every integer in the inclusive query range must belong to at least one inclusive interval.
hints: An inclusive interval adds one at its start and removes one immediately after its end.
Prefix-sum the difference array to obtain the active interval count at every integer.
Reject when any value from left through right has active count zero.
The prefix count equals the number of intervals covering each value, so positivity throughout the query is necessary and sufficient.
editorial: The prefix count equals the number of intervals covering each value, so positivity throughout the query is necessary and sufficient.

tests.explanation: Two through five are covered by the three adjacent intervals.
Twenty-one lies outside every interval, so coverage fails.
